examples.title: Basic video player
examples.description: Play, pause, and seek from the media controls. Only https, http, and blob sources load.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { VideoPlayer } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<VideoPlayer src="https://example.com/media/intro.mp4" label="Product introduction" poster="https://example.com/media/intro.jpg" />

examples.title: Unavailable source
examples.description: A source whose scheme is not https, http, or blob never loads and renders the unavailable controls.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { VideoPlayer } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<VideoPlayer src="data:text/html,unsupported" label="Blocked source" />
